$comment: Risk classification for orchestrator PRs — proposed at /orchestrator:enable-orchestrator, EDITABLE ANYTIME (re-read each run, no re-enable needed). Effect: reviewers focus on what this file flags high; OK stays per-PR, never bulk.
$comment_forgeProtection: ADR-0032. required = branch protection on main is verified at the forge (default). unavailable-accepted = the forge CANNOT provide it on this plan (GitHub free + private answers 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public'; no token shape is branch-scopable) and the operator accepted the exposure — auto-merge is then force-disabled whatever autoMergeRiskLevels says, so every merge stays human. Set at /orchestrator:enable-orchestrator; this field IS the record — do not restate it in prose.
